description: Use when: is it safe to send to these BNB Smart Chain addresses? Up to 20 BNB Smart Chain recipients in one call for $0.05. Same heuristics as the single safe-to-send route (lookalike poisoning when from is set, dust spam, scam flags, contract handling, fresh empty addresses). Results stay in request order. A failed or timed-out recipient is marked on that item; the batch still returns. Costs $0.05.
name: bsc_safe_to_send_batch
